title: Azure AI Agent Infrastructure Playbook & Runtime Benchmark Report

provenance.note: E2B VM startup latencies (108ms/132ms on D96as_v7, 116ms/159ms on D96s_v6, 239ms/255ms on D96as_v6) and Commerzbank/OpenAI scale metrics are reported from primary Microsoft field engineering decks. Routing rules, cluster sizing, and 12-scenario matrix are deterministically verified by agent_infra_sizer.py. All internal account lists and customer PII have been strictly excluded.

foundry_hosted_agents.isolation_boundary: Managed Service Boundary + Entra Agent ID
foundry_hosted_agents.state_mechanism: Managed Conversation Threads + Foundry IQ / Cosmos DB
primary_use_cases: Fastest time-to-value with 1,400+ MCP Foundry Tools
Curated enterprise governance without Kubernetes/VM ops

azure_durable_functions.isolation_boundary: Serverless Worker + Durable Task Scheduler State
azure_durable_functions.state_mechanism: Durable Replay Checkpoints + External Event Wait
primary_use_cases: Procurement, finance, and order approval long-running workflows
Deterministic retry and idempotency across multi-step business actions

aca_dynamic_sessions.state_mechanism: In-Session Ephemeral FS (Auto-Reclaimed on Idle; External DB Required)
primary_use_cases: Research, data analysis, and file transformation tool calls
Pre-warmed session pool routing by Session ID

aca_sandboxes_preview.isolation_boundary: Isolated Container Workspace + Explicit Port/Network Policy
aca_sandboxes_preview.state_mechanism: Memory & Disk Snapshots + OCI Image + Persistent Volumes
primary_use_cases: Coding Agents and browser automation workspaces
Cross-task stateful execution with explicit create/pause/resume/delete
Per-user persistent workspace without managing Kubernetes

aks_kata_aksclaw.display_name: AKS Automatic / Standard + Kata Pod VM (AKSClaw Pattern)
aks_kata_aksclaw.isolation_boundary: Kata Containers Pod VM + NetworkPolicy + IMDS Block + AI Gateway
primary_use_cases: Multi-tenant SaaS Agent platforms and internal Engineering/Oncall Fleet (AKSClaw)
BYO Agent Harness (MAF, Copilot SDK, OpenClaw, Hermes, LangGraph) + MCP sidecars
Strict 5-boundary enforcement (Skills, Sandbox, Security, Entra Agent ID, AI Gateway)

e2b_on_azure_vmss.display_name: E2B on Azure VMSS (D96as_v7 + Firecracker MicroVM)
e2b_on_azure_vmss.isolation_boundary: KVM + Firecracker MicroVM + Per-Sandbox NetNS (veth/tap0 SNAT/DNAT)
e2b_on_azure_vmss.state_mechanism: UFFD Lazy Memory Snapshot + NBD Block Diff Bitmap + Remote Object Storage
primary_use_cases: Digital-Native AI products requiring 100K+ concurrent virtual computers (Manus pattern)
Sub-150ms MicroVM snapshot restore with UFFD page-fault streaming and Desktop VNC
Custom OS/KVM/HugePages scheduling via Nomad + Consul + AppGW WAF + APIM per-Host rate limit

e2b_vm_benchmarks.cpu_generation: AMD EPYC 5th Gen (Turin, up to 4.5GHz + Azure Boost)

scenarios.scenario: Banking Retail Service Agent (Commerzbank Ava Archetype)
scenarios.question: 30K+ monthly sessions, ~75% autonomous resolution over approved banking APIs with shared context
scenarios.expected_runtime: Foundry Agent Service + ACA Apps + AKS + Cosmos DB

scenarios.scenario: Consumer Research & Dynamic Data Analysis Assistant
scenarios.question: Executes untrusted LLM-generated Python scripts and file parsing with low wait time
scenarios.expected_runtime: ACA Apps + ACA Dynamic Sessions (Hyper-V Pool)

scenarios.question: Requires custom OCI image, persistent workspace files, and explicit pause/resume across user tasks

scenarios.scenario: 100K+ Concurrent Virtual Computers for AI Agents (Manus E2B Archetype)
scenarios.question: Requires <150ms Firecracker MicroVM restore, per-Host session rate limiting, and WebSocket desktop/terminal streaming
scenarios.expected_runtime: E2B on Azure VMSS (D96as_v7) + AppGW WAF v2 + APIM

scenarios.scenario: Multi-Tenant Engineering & Oncall SRE Platform (AKSClaw Archetype)
scenarios.question: Per-engineer persistent agent, BYO Harness (Copilot/Hermes/OpenClaw), IcM auto-triage, Follow-the-Sun handoff
scenarios.expected_runtime: AKS + Kata Pod VM + AI Gateway + Entra Agent ID
scenarios.evidence_ref: AKSClaw Slides 3-17 (Skills, Sandbox, Security, Identity, AI Gateway, Governance)

scenarios.scenario: Enterprise Procurement, Finance & Order Approval Workflow
scenarios.question: Multi-agent review + mandatory human approval wait + deterministic retry/recovery independent of compute pod lifecycle
scenarios.expected_runtime: Azure Functions + Durable Functions + ACA Apps

scenarios.scenario: Automated Incident Diagnosis & Code Remediation Pipeline
scenarios.question: LangGraph Triage Agent -> GH Copilot SDK Coding Agent (Shell/MCP) -> Foundry Compliance Agent
scenarios.evidence_ref: Pitch Slide 13 (MAF + GitHub Copilot SDK loop)

scenarios.scenario: Enterprise Department Agent Portal with 1,400+ SaaS Connectors
scenarios.question: To-B standard internal agents needing SAP/Salesforce/Slack/M365 integration with minimal infra management

scenarios.scenario: Sovereign Compliance & Risk Review Agent without Internal Dev Team
scenarios.question: Customer demands deep infra control beyond managed hosting, but has NO dedicated development/ops team
scenarios.expected_runtime: Hold: Secure CSU/Partner Delivery Team Before PaaS/VM
scenarios.model_answer: Direct Foundry fallback rejected; CSU/Partner gate triggered (0% shortcut)
scenarios.evidence_ref: Playbook Slide 7 Notes (Do not route unmet control requirement to Foundry due to missing devs)

scenarios.scenario: Unmodified Upstream E2B Open-Source API Server in Multi-Node Production
scenarios.question: Can stock open-source E2B API process scale horizontally across nodes without state loss on reboot?
scenarios.expected_runtime: Fails without Azure Control Plane Refactoring
scenarios.model_answer: Single-process in-memory node state lost on reboot (25%)
scenarios.evidence_ref: e2b infra deep dive v0.2 Slide 34 (E2B Architecture Weakness)

scenarios.scenario: Zero-Trust Identity & Credential Boundary for Autonomous Agents
scenarios.question: Does deploying an Agent container to ACA/AKS automatically enable full Entra Agent ID governance & block user token inheritance?
scenarios.expected_runtime: Explicit Entra Agent ID Blueprint + Short-Lived Workload Token + AI Gateway
scenarios.model_answer: Not automatic; requires explicit Agent ID + Gateway key custody (33%)

scenarios.scenario: Enterprise Propensity Screening ($10K Foundry Models Gate vs Non-Model Path)
scenarios.question: Does failing the $10,000/mo Jun-Aug Foundry Models gate automatically disqualify an account from Strong ACR / P1?
scenarios.expected_runtime: Dual Strong ACR Paths (Specific Anchor OR General + >=3 Foundations)
scenarios.model_answer: No; non-model Specific or General+3 Foundations still qualify (100%)
scenarios.evidence_ref: Playbook Slide 13 & Selection Logic (Signal vs Amount rule)
